label: Running/fresh relation pair
requirement: Treat 16 bounded CE claims as one running bundle R1 and the selected committed CCS claim as R2, with the same relation and Ajtai key.
remaining: Complete use by the sole production lifecycle.

label: Deterministic one-message folding verifier
requirement: Consume one local proof and compute an optional next running bundle through the exact deterministic NIFS verifier.
remaining: Connect the accepted assignment's actual proof and output to this verifier.

label: Decode every satisfying assignment
requirement: Every accepted assignment of the selected F′ relation decodes to designated advice and public values satisfying the complete selected F′ execution.
remaining: The full theorem takes canonical bound raw assignments. Actual-assignment soundness still leaves exact PiDEC/output and selected-context connections.

label: Encode a valid augmented execution
requirement: A valid selected augmented execution has a satisfying canonical assignment with the designated advice and public output.
remaining: Logical child completeness exists; complete selected-package honest-execution and production witness generation.

label: Structure independent of witness
requirement: Application, matrices and key identity depend on verifier-owned inputs, not on prover advice.
remaining: Use the same selected package in production.

label: Canonical public-instance inverse
requirement: The public digest encoding is injective and decodes every canonical four-word digest.
remaining: Close selected public-layout executable parity.

label: Size ordering for the claimed compiler family
requirement: A Definition 12 compiler-family claim needs the stated nondecreasing structure-size rule. A fixed selected application can use its explicit finite fit.
remaining: No generic monotonicity theorem was established by this review. Do not mark it missing or require a generic theorem to reuse the selected fit.

label: Compact recursive key and instance interface
requirement: Fix all key values read by NIFS before encoding F′; bind unused complete structures by an identifier instead of carrying their matrices as recursive advice.
remaining: Compact types and a finite plan exist. Complete the selected authority and digest-only statement binding.

label: Committed default satisfies every selected running relation
requirement: All 16 default CE claims have valid zero openings, including commitment, public projection, low norm, point and both evaluation families.
remaining: The semantic default theorem is closed. Connect production initialization to this value.

label: State domain tag

remaining: Close selected full-state serialization parity.

remaining: The context words are represented, but their selected authority is a further obligation.
